evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~6 ppm to 24.3 ppm during growth instead of staying low
Tube pressure drifting upward 3.00 -> 3.21 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure/O2 rise is not from flow change

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, and a leak check (close Ar / isolate pump) to distinguish an air in-leak from exhaust restriction; post-growth characterization of the sample.
